# controld_rule_folders (Data Source)

Lists the custom rule folders (groups) of a ControlD profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "controld_rule_folders" "home" {
  profile_id = controld_profile.home.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `profile_id` (String) The identifier of the profile to list rule folders for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this data source, equal to `profile_id`.
- `rule_folders` (Attributes List) The list of rule folders. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_folders))

<a id="nestedatt--rule_folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_folders`

Read-Only:

- `do` (Number) The action applied to hostnames in this folder.
- `id` (String) The rule folder identifier (PK), usable as `group` in a `controld_custom_rule` resource.
- `name` (String) The name of the rule folder.
- `rules_count` (Number) The number of rules contained in this folder.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the rule folder is enabled.
